purpose: Generated backdrop imagery for standalone machine showcase. Not factory photographs.

prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: full-bleed background image for an interactive three-machine industrial product showcase. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 high-resolution photorealistic environment plate, empty of products, machines and people. Art direction: a beautifully designed industrial photography pavilion, architectural structural steel, brushed aluminum wall ribs, overhead clerestory windows, a sophisticated medium graphite-gray polished concrete floor with restrained reflections, a long softbox skylight and dramatic but believable broad diagonal window shadows. Distinct spatial architecture and tactile surfaces, photographic contrast and depth, not a plain gradient. Camera looks slightly down into a broad empty floor, horizon in the upper third. Keep central 65% visually quiet and unobstructed so separately rendered milling machine, lathe and laser cutter can sit there; frame the space with architectural details toward the upper perimeter and sides, and keep center visible in a narrow mobile crop. Neutral white daylight with a little warm industrial light, realistic photographic material. No raised podium, no stairs, no machinery, no furniture in center, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no futuristic neon. This is the background asset itself, not a screenshot or website mockup.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed cinematic environment plate for an industrial machine assembly animation. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 high-resolution image, a memorable art-directed industrial vortex environment, empty of machines and products. A vast dark graphite industrial volume with a calm smooth medium-gray reflective ground, and sculptural silver-gray wisps of airborne dust and fine vapor sweeping in a broad open spiral around the perimeter, widest above, narrower toward the ground. Side-lit by large photographic softboxes, delicate pale amber specular glints on a very small number of metallic dust flecks. The spiral should feel like physically photographed flowing air illuminated in an industrial studio, organic volumetric wisps and atmospheric depth, not geometric circles, not drawn lines, not a neon tunnel. Keep the central 60% open and clear for three separately rendered industrial machines, with light gray floor and soft dark midtone behind them so both silver and dark painted objects will read. Strong visual design, controlled contrast, rich black-to-silver layers. Camera looks slightly down at the open ground; keep the central mobile crop composed. No people, no machines, no debris chunks, no destruction, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks. This is an environment image only, not a website mockup.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: full-bleed engineering drafting environment backdrop for a 3D machine showcase. Generate ONE landscape 16:9 high-resolution photographic mixed-media editorial image, designed and tactile rather than a computer grid. A large precision engineering drafting studio with layered translucent vellum technical drawings and oversized desaturated Prussian-blue blueprint sheets suspended along the rear wall and the side margins, showing intricate faint exploded mechanical studies and machining sections as genuine printed ink on paper. A brushed pale-steel drafting surface / open matte cool gray floor recedes into the center, soft realistic directional light and cast paper-edge shadows, tiny restrained warm brass highlights on a ruler and a steel caliper far at the extreme edges. The CENTRAL 65% is an unobstructed light cool gray open presentation space for three separate 3D machine models; detailed blueprint studies concentrate around upper third and left/right edges, still visibly textured in a central mobile crop. Designed asymmetry, strong paper layering, sophisticated photographic depth. Low angle slightly looking down into open ground, not a flat top-down desktop. Do not show any physical machine, human, monitor or device in center. No readable text, no legible dimensions or numerals, no logos, no watermark, no artificial neon, not simply lines over a colored background. Deliver only the background artwork, no web UI.
